name: Shinjouji Ayane
source: One of the childhood gang's members. She is one year older than the others, and the very gentle, big sister-like girl. Openminded and a bit of an airhead, a steady and unpretentious girl. The protagonist's childhood friend, he considers her the same as his own sister and has always admired her. Works as a maid at Shouko's house. She keeps the reason why she works as a maid a secret.
